environment_contract.ssp_conversion_policy: Convert attenuation at every SSP node depth before complex C/N/P/S interpolation.
environment_contract.flat_acoustic_halfspace_depth_policy: Use the ordinary ENV half-space material-record depth, matching ReadEnvironmentBell.f90; long ATI/BTY material records remain I3-06 scope.

floating_point_contract.francois_garrison: Origin REAL(4) constants are promoted explicitly; A3/P2/P3 use fixed nested FMA order; Clang pow builtin replacement is disabled only for attenuation.cpp.
floating_point_contract.biological: Each matching layer is converted from dB/km to Np/m before ordered accumulation, matching AttenMod.f90.

intentional_validation_differences: F2CPP rejects non-finite Francois-Garrison and biological parameters.
F2CPP requires temperature greater than -273 C, non-negative salinity/mean depth/coefficient, positive f0/Q, ordered depth bounds, and at most 200 biological layers.

standard_case_commands: standard_cases.py test --version origin --case <two I4-02 cases> --profile <single or broadband_smoke> --executable <origin executable> --results-root <results root>
standard_cases.py test --version f2cpp --case <two I4-02 cases> --profile <single or broadband_smoke> --executable <f2cpp executable> --results-root <results root>
standard_cases.py test --version <origin or f2cpp> --case constant_speed_no_attenuation_5khz --profile single --executable <matching executable> --results-root <results root>
generation.report_assembly: Curated summary of validator output plus exact component-oracle and ownership contracts; all executable and output hashes are copied verbatim from the validator.
